{{Quote|On Felucia, the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hellhole and dared the Republic to come in after them. So we did, only to be met with the month after month of flesh-eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators and other sights that haunt me to this day.|[[Retired clone trooper|Retired 501st clone trooper]]|<ref name="BFII" />}}
The '''Battle of Felucia''' occurred late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. It was initially a mission assigned to the [[182nd Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to combat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces which had taken control of the planet. When contact with the 182nd was lost, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was deployed to investigate their disappearance.

After the 501st secured the area, the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] (CC-5052) arrived and began a manhunt for the Separatist leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], who was believed to be holding [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] prisoner. Following her rescue, the battle quickly shifted to an attempt to stop the spread of deadly toxins from contaminating Felucia's water supply. In the midst of the battle, the [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] protocol issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was received, and the Jedi were shot dead by their own men.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|As you can see, we still tend to our wounds from the last Republic assault. Felucia cannot withstand another.|A [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Administrator/Legends|administress]], to [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="RoF" />}}
[[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|Earlier in the war]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led an assault on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and secured the planet for the Separatists. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Anakin's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], were sent to save the planet. However, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] force was greatly outnumbered and the Jedi were forced to retreat, failing in their mission.<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>

==The battle==
{{Quote|The same trigger that destroyed the compound also unleashed a highly poisonous biological agent into the water supply. Felucia has a natural planet-wide aquatic distribution system. Ekria's simulations indicate that the toxin will infect the entire planet in four days&hellip; resulting in the death of millions of sentients.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="RoF" />}}
It began with the landing of the [[182nd Legion]]. The very first phase of the battle was the [[182nd Legion]] attacking the Felucian blockade by the CIS. They were taken out with mild difficulty.
[[File:FeluciaLandscape-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The battleground.]]

Yet when they landed on the surface, the clones quickly found that Felucia had a nightmarish topography. With dense foliage and seemingly infinite jungles and spores, ambushes were common, and heavier support vehicles were hard to use. Eventually the 182nd were overrun and feared lost and the Republic called in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] for help.<ref name="BFII" />

Upon landing, the 501st sent a patrol to scout ahead, but their transmission was abruptly cut off by blaster fire, screams and an unearthly screeching noise. Moving forward, the troopers encountered six feral [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], which had decimated both the 182nd and the patrol. Rockets and mines were used to great effect, but the group suffered heavy casualties. Two gunships tried to land to reinforce the group, but one gunship was shot by AA guns and crashed in the brush nearby.<ref name="BFII" />
[[File:BF_Felucia_2.jpg|thumb|right|225px|501st troopers harassed by acklays.]]

501st members protected a severely damaged [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] from [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] and [[assault droid]]s for some time. About fifty advanced down the hill. They attempted to destroy the vehicle with rockets, but it had little effect, and that made the droids easy targets for the clones. After the onslaught, the clones repaired the vehicle by taking a power cell from the downed Republic gunship and using it to re-power the walker to make use of it.<ref name="BFII" />

Eventually [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] arrived on Felucia alongside her unit, the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], and was able to lead the 501st contingent to rout the Separatist defenders at a high cost of troops. It was here that Secura dubbed the 501st "the bravest men she had ever seen". Armed with dual lightsabers, Secura cut through the droid ranks to recover a powercell from the crashed gunship and powered up the walker, causing devastation to the CIS tanks advancing on their position.<ref name="BFII" />

[[File:BF_Felucia_1.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Aayla Secura fighting alongside clone troopers.]]
The Republic troops then preceded to destroy six Anti-Vehicle turrets that were causing damage to Republic forces from the area near the fungal tree, and moved on.<ref name="BFII" />

As part of the hunt for [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], Secura and her troops arrived at the [[Nigkoe Detention Facility/Legends|Nigkoe Detention Facility]] where they believed Jedi Knight [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was being held prisoner.

Attacking the facility, the clone troopers, under the command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], Gen. Secura's second-in-command, engaged the [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Gossam Commandos]] and secured the area while Secura freed both Offee and her [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]].

Still on the trail of Mai, Jedi Generals Secura and Offee, along with the 327th Star Corps clone troop infantry under the command of Bly, arrived at her heavily fortified compound outside of [[Kway Teow/Legends|Kway Teow]]. After creating a diversion that destroyed several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] guards, the Jedi and clones advanced on Aratech [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] bikes toward the compound. They were attacked by several droid starfighters, but these were dealt with by a Republic squad of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]].

Having entered the compound through a lake and waterfall-access, and let their troops inside, Aayla Secura, Barriss Offee and Padawans [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]] and Zonder found that their search was for naught; Shu Mai's personal ship had left days ago and no one had entered or left the compound since.

[[File:ATOTATTEFelucia-BTCG.png|thumb|right|270px|An [[All Terrain Open Transport/Legends|AT-OT walker]] on Felucia.]]
While gathering information on the ongoing [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack on Coruscant]], the Jedi were informed by Commander Bly that the compound was filling up with toxins. A countdown sequence had also begun, which prompted Secura to order a full withdrawal from the area.
Moments before the compound exploded, the Jedi and their troops managed to escape.

A clone trooper task force of the 327th Star Corps infantry, under the command of General Secura, prepared to attack several of Felucia's water treatment facilities to prevent the Gossam homeworld from being infected by a toxin released into the water supply. This situation had come about due to a self-destruct mechanism designed by Presidente Mai.

The clone trooper reinforcements, brought in by Jedi General [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], who then went on to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], were briefed on the situation by Commander Bly. It was stated that Felucia's defenses were heaviest against air assault, thus a ground attack would be most effective. Since the jungle would slow them down, Jedi Knight Barriss Offee would lead one squad to [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]], while a second squad, led by Jedi Padawans Ekria, Zonder, and the newly-arrived [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]], would target [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]]. General Secura's squad would accompany the Padawans and then proceed to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].

The 327th Star Corps task force then split up and headed into the woods.
[[File:BlyShootsAayla.png|thumb|left|Upon the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Protocol 66]], as called for the summary execution of the Jedi as traitors, General Aayla Secura was shot and killed by [[327th Star Corps/Legends|her troops]] in the 327th.]]
As the Padawans' force reached Jiaozi, they staged a diversionary attack and withdrawal, to lure the guards away from the water treatment facilities and allow the three Jedi access. The toxins were restrained from spreading further, but remote access to the other stations was impossible, as they each were on an isolated network. Padawan Ekria then tried to raise Generals Secura and Offee, but failed as the transmissions were being jammed. In an attempt at finding out the state of the other forces, Ekria gained access to cameras installed inside clone trooper helmets. This feat might possibly have saved the three Padawans from certain death, as [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was given a few minutes later.

When the order was given, Barriss Offee was under siege from B-2 battle droids. Having seen Lieutenant [[Galle/Legends|Galle]] arrive with reinforcements, she ordered him to open fire. She was subsequently shot to death by an AT-TE walker and her own troops.

Aayla Secura had stopped on her way to Niango, due to reports of a Separatist armored unit in the area. As her troops waited, Secura was distracted by a bird suddenly taking flight, while at the same moment Commander Bly received Order 66 and proceeded to shoot his commanding officer in the back before she could even react. Aayla Secura was finished off by concentrated fire from the clones surrounding her.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Cut off, and for all we knew, abandoned by our superiors, our only hope was Aayla Secura, our Jedi commander. Without her iron will, none of us would come out of that mess with our sanity&hellip; or our lives.|Anonymous 501st trooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
Having witnessed the slaughter of their seniors, the three Padawans situated at Jiaozi water treatment facilities escaped their own troops and fled the planet.

After containing the toxins and saving the planet, the newly established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] absorbed Felucia into its control.
